description: Per-dimension grading contract for the M5 chassis repair + salvage + clear-jam sandbox. Drives every chassis-grade cfctl method through the production cf-control dispatch path without combat pressure. Agent reads evidence (events.jsonl + observe.once + cargo tests) and writes prose-justified scores.

dimensions.criterion: act.chassis.repair restores module HP + transitions module state back to Nominal; emits `chassis.module_state_changed` with reason `repaired:<reason>`. Repair zone restores every bound module + mends joints.
evidence_required: events.jsonl chassis.module_state_changed with reason repaired:* rows

dimensions.criterion: act.chassis.clear_jam clears the weapon_jammed flag on the chassis and emits `chassis.weapon_cleared {via: manual}`. Returns CommandResult::accepted regardless of whether a jam existed (idempotent).

act.player.crouch / climb / jet toggles update actor.crouch_active / climb_active / jet_active in observe.once. Stance derives Crouching / Climbing / Jetting / Ejecting accordingly. Jet requires Jet module nominal/degraded — Warning + Failed reject with `jet_module_unavailable`.
evidence_required: events.jsonl actor.animation_event rows for crouch_started/ended + jet_thrust_started/ended

dimensions.criterion: act.chassis.salvage on a wrecked chassis pulls every non-Failed + >=25%-integrity module into chassis.salvaged_modules, emits `chassis.salvaged` with salvaged_module_ids[]. Non-wrecked chassis reject with `chassis_not_wreck_or_disabled`.
cf-save round-trips chassis state (zones + modules + pilot binding + stage + weapon_jammed) through JSON serialization with blake3 checksum. Damage applied before save is preserved across load.
evidence_required: cargo test -p cf-save passes save_blob_round_trips_with_chassis + chassis_damage_persists_through_roundtrip + checksum_mismatch_is_detected

dimensions.criterion: observe.once exposes the post-repair / post-salvage chassis state changes. Repair restores zone integrity > 0.99 + modules to Nominal. Salvage populates salvaged_module_ids in the chassis projection.
evidence_required: observe.once before + after each repair/salvage step
